messages.subject: Spatial-temporal SPDE: exchangeable
parts:
Hello,

Having solved the AR1 model, I am now dealing with 2 more models. The spatial-temporal SPDE model with AR1 correlation that I managed to implement is:

Y_ti ~ Distribution(mu_ti)
mu_ij = Covariates_ti + v_ti
v_ti = rho * _t-1,i + u_ti

Suppose I have data from 10 years. t is the year index. Different sampling locations i per year.

Following the Godin et al paper, there are two more models that I would like to implement:

#Exchanagable correlation
f <- y ~ -1 + Intercept + Covariates +
            f(i,
             model = spde,
             group = i.group,
             control.group = list(model='exchangeable'))



and also a model with the replicate option:

A2 <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh,
                                     repl = Year,
                                     loc = Loc)

Ind <- inla.spde.make.index(name = 'i',
                                               n.spde = mesh$n,
                                               n.repl = 10)

Stk <- inla.stack(
                tag = "Fit",
               data = list(y = Data$Y), 
               A = list(A2, 1),                 
               effects = list(                
                  Ind,        
                  Covariates))

f2    <- y ~ -1 + Covariates +
             f(i,
              model = spde,
             replicate = i.repl)


It all runs fine....but my questions are:

1. What exactly is the mathematical expression for the spatial-temporal model with the exchangaeble correlation? I am familiar with the underlying idea of exchangaeble correlation in for example GEE; somewhere is a covariance matrix with only rho's. But where?

2. Same question for the replicate model. What is the underlying mathematical equation? Is this like the spatial-temporal AR1 model but with rho set to 0? I see that for each year I have a different spatial random field, and I understand that they all have the same hyper-parameters. So that would just be:

mu_ti = Covariates_ti + v_ti

And the 10 spatial random field for  v_ti  all have same same hyperparameters?


Kind regards,

Pieter
